from dataclasses import dataclass, field

@dataclass
class Item:
    name: str
    price: int
    tags: list = field(default_factory=list)

a = Item("펜", 1000)
b = Item("펜", 1000)
print(a)
print(a == b)
a.tags.append("문구")
print(a.tags, b.tags)

@dataclass(frozen=True, order=True)
class Ver:
    major: int
    minor: int
v = Ver(1, 2)
print(v < Ver(1, 3), {v: "ok"})
v.major = 9
